answer.answer: Under PMFBY, the maximum premium rates farmers can pay are: 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops [E02], 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops [E02], and 5% for yearly commercial or horticultural crops [E02]. The remaining premium is subsidized by the government [E02].

claim_to_evidence.claim: Maximum premium for Kharif food and oilseed crops is 2%
Maximum premium for Rabi food and oilseed crops is 1.5%
Maximum premium for yearly commercial or horticultural crops is 5%
The remaining premium is subsidized by the government
